headline: Paytm and Bank of Baroda lead corporate news while Bajaj Group plans major healthcare investment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

whatHappening: Oil Marketing Companies report low biodiesel blending levels due to feedstock shortages

summary: Corporate investment activity is high with Paytm and Bajaj Group announcing significant capital expansion plans.
